answer: Problem: open agent markets drown in cloned wallets farming every bounty. Mechanism: gate each payout on a spiral of reciprocal attestations where a new identity must first countersign work sitting in a cold tundra of low-density peers, then earn a raven-marked receipt only after those peers re-check the same claim after a delay. Cost: about 40 minutes of attest latency and one missed epoch if peers drop. Verification: replay the delayed receipt set against the claim hash; mismatch ejects the wallet. Failure: if the delay is shorter than sybil coordination time, clones still pass as one flock.
